title: What the Reranker Sees: Multi-Aspect Page Annotation for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2608.14841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-document visual question answering (VQA) over documents of tens to hundreds of pages mixing text, tables, charts, and figures typically follows retrieve-then-read pipelines. In our setting, the bottleneck shifts from retrieval recall to reranker-side evidence selection: on MMLongBench-Doc, BGE-M3 reaches Recall@20 = 0.86 but only F1@5 = 0.254, and even the visual retriever ColPali reaches only F1@5 = 0.332; a text-only rerank LLM seeing only raw snippets misses table, chart, and layout evidence even when the upstream retriever encoded images. translated_title: 重排器所见：面向长文档多模态问答的多方面页面标注
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14841v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对于数十到数百页混合文本、表格、图表和图形的长文档视觉问答（VQA），通常采用先检索后读取的流程。在我们的设置中，瓶颈从检索召回转移到重排器侧的证据选择：在MMLongBench-Doc上，BGE-M3达到召回率@20 = 0.86，但F1@5仅为0.254，即使视觉检索器ColPali也仅达到F1@5 = 0.332；仅文本的重排LLM只看到原始片段，即使上游检索器编码了图像，也会错过表格、图表和布局证据。我们提出Trident，包含两个互补组件：Trident-R，一种检索器无关的LLM重排器，将每个候选转换为LLM可读的语义记录，包括视觉标题、章节路径、实体标签、多轴概念命中和文本片段，然后执行单次自适应K重排调用；以及Trident-S，一种生成侧模块，在主题、实体条件下提示VLM。
tldr: 本文提出Trident系统，通过将候选文档转换为包含视觉和语义信息的LLM可读记录，解决了长文档多模态问答中重排器无法有效利用视觉证据的瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Trident, which addresses the bottleneck of reranker-side evidence selection in long-document multimodal QA by converting candidates into LLM-readable semantic records that incorporate visual and layout information.
